maddeler.e:
نحقق (form I)
# نَحْقِقْ (naḥqiq) /naħ.qiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# نَحْقُقْ (naḥquq) /naħ.quq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# نُحْقَقْ (nuḥqaq) /nuħ.qaq/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
